title: Median Employee Salary
goal: Solve Median Employee Salary: Write a SQL query to find the median salary of each company, returning the id, company and salary of the median row(s) per company.
strategy: Write a SQL query to find the median salary of each company, returning the id, company and salary of the median row(s) per company.
edgeCases: Even-sized employee groups have two middle positions, and ties need stable ordering under the query’s ranking convention.
inputRules: Enter at least one row: id,company,salary
Keep the table to 30 rows or fewer
